A restored server starts isolated (operational_state restore:isolated and admission suspended_restore): admission is paused, schedules, integrations and outbox dispatch read application.operations.isolated() and do nothing, alert evaluation is skipped, and isolation ends only when an operator confirms the restore review and releases it; the DR rehearsal records the same gates on a fresh stack.

On PostgreSQL a real backup restored into a fresh database starts isolated with every integration paused and every token dropped: every registered server controller and the scheduler do nothing, no notification leaves, no check or comment is published and an inbound webhook is refused without being recorded, even after an administrator resumed the integrations.
